config.title: Capital of France
config.question: Which city is the capital of France?

answers.feedback: Lyon is France's third-largest city, but not the capital.
Marseille is France's largest port city, but not the capital.

config.title: Continents
config.question: Which two continents share the largest land border?

answers.feedback: Correct. They form Eurasia, often divided at the Ural Mountains.
They are joined only by the narrow Isthmus of Panama.
They are joined only at the Sinai Peninsula.

config.title: Mountain ranges
config.text: The longest mountain range above sea level is the *Andes*, which runs along the western coast of *South America*.
